selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05:F18 R108 MANAGED Texture2D registry mirror readiness/ownership proof.
summary: R108 adds a registry-level observation-only managed-mirror preparation API and a non-binding readiness snapshot. The snapshot proves registered D3D9 texture identity, CPU-shadow validity, concrete D3D11 mirror resource ownership, managed lifetime currentness, exact expected D3D11 device ownership, device generation, CPU-shadow version, mirror generation and mirror shadow version without exposing a raw registry SRV. Hosted validation proves foreign-device rejection, R107 mutation invalidation, LockRect recapture recovery, Reset invalidation and post-Reset generation-correct recreation.

Runtime/HMD correctness is not inferred from hosted CI.
